puzzle.hint: A mental faculty whose absence causes regret on the Day of Judgment — the disbelievers wish they had employed it alongside listening
puzzle.arabicVerse: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
puzzle.verse: 67:10 - And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."
